source: pi-jev skill applicability wording (the requested activity is the candidate's activity; a shared topic alone is not enough), plus a choice question that shortlists a large catalog; v2: skillThreshold 0.6 → 0.5 so a 0.55 write-doc pick is not hidden when the catalog is trimmed; v3: scriptFirst — `paths:` globs on skills and routed rules match the paths a prompt names or a harness touched before Jev (a rule hit is selected, a skill hit is always asked); v4: injectThreshold 0.85 / injectMax 1 / injectMaxChars 12000 — the top skill at p ≥ 0.85 arrives with its SKILL.md body (selection is unchanged, so v3 metrics hold); v6: chooseDescriptionChars 260 → 160, a shorter stage-1 catalog (stage 2 keeps 420); v7: design intent 261023 (AGENTS.md) — no stage-1 single-choice shortlist: every candidate is asked as a bool in one call (directBelow 999), so a second needed skill is not squeezed out; general routing judgments (pasted payload is not the request, an error in a running app asks for reproduction) live in apply.instructions instead of skill descriptions; injectMax 1 → 2; v8: synthetic-scenario loop 261023 (docs/plan/261023-synthetic-routing-loop.md), train only — sibling extras recur across scenarios (analyze-claude-sessions beside analyze-pi-sessions; build-tui and write-a-skill beside improve-skill/write-a-rule), so apply.instructions says a sibling for another object is false unless named or implied, and a thing named only as the object being edited is not the activity; v9: + standing-rule situation test — svelte-effects/frontend-consistency injected as unneeded in 5+ scenarios (offline train and real sessions) whenever any Svelte UI work was requested

choose.noneDescription: No candidate's activity is requested: general questions, chit-chat, or work no listed skill or rule specialises in
choose.instructions: Which single candidate covers the main activity `request` asks for? Judge the work the user wants done, not the topics they mention: a shared topic alone is not enough. Read `conversation_excerpt` only when the request is a short follow-up that makes sense in context. Pick `none` when no candidate's activity is requested.

apply.instructions: Is the work `request` asks for the activity that this {kind} covers? {kind}: {name}. {description} Answer true only when the user is asking for that activity itself; a shared topic alone is not enough. Pasted material (inspector references, element JSON, logs, quoted text) is payload that says where, not what to do. An error reported in a running app asks for reproducing it there and fixing the code that throws. A candidate that serves a sibling object (another harness, tool, framework or product) is false unless the request names or implies that object. Something named only as the object being edited, analysed or reviewed is not the activity; the editing, analysing or reviewing is. A standing rule applies when the work reaches the situation it governs; working in the same framework or area is not enough. Read `conversation_excerpt` only when the request is a short follow-up.
apply.true: The requested activity is the one this {kind} covers
apply.false: The request only shares a topic with it, or asks for something else
